lyrics:
[Intro: clean reverb guitar riff, tight dry drums, low bass]

[Verse 1: low, quick, half rapped murmur]
Windows down in a cold parked car
Talking like we know who we are
Your breath on the glass, you draw a house
I add a door, you rub it out
Radio's playing something our parents knew
You know the words and I look at you

[Pre-Chorus: drums thin, guitar rings]
It's colder than they said it'd be
You're shaking and you're laughing at me

[Chorus: half-time feel, clear falsetto, wide guitars]
Take the flannel, it's not mine
I borrowed it from somebody kind
It's been around, it'll go around
Wear it till the leaves come down
It's borrowed, borrowed, borrowed
And so are we, for now

[Verse 2: low, quick, half rapped murmur]
Sleeves too long and the collar's frayed
It smells like smoke and lemonade
You can wear it how you like out here
Nobody's looking, nobody's near
One button's wrong and it suits you fine
You do it up crooked, just like mine

[Pre-Chorus: drums thin, guitar rings]
It's colder than they said it'd be
You're shaking and you're laughing at me

[Chorus: half-time feel, clear falsetto, wide guitars]
Take the flannel, it's not mine
I borrowed it from somebody kind
It's been around, it'll go around
Wear it till the leaves come down
It's borrowed, borrowed, borrowed
And so are we, for now

[Bridge: tempo drops, slow and heavy, voice lower]
Somebody wore it before me
Somebody will after you
Pass it on, pass it on
When it's warmed you through

[Outro: slow tempo, guitar and voice, fading]
Borrowed, borrowed, borrowed
Pass it on
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 124 BPM, 4/4, E minor, with the choruses felt at half speed and the last section slowed to about 92 BPM. Cool, moody and close.

VOICE: Male, low and murmured, delivering the verses fast and rhythmically, half rapped, as if not to be overheard. The chorus is slow, with a clear, light falsetto on the top line and a doubled low voice underneath. Lower and slower still in the bridge.

INSTRUMENTS: A clean electric guitar with heavy reverb playing a short, descending riff. A tight, dry, hip-hop-influenced drum kit. Deep, simple bass. A second guitar with tremolo. Dark synth pads. Finger snaps in the pre-chorus. The whole track is treated to sound slightly monochrome.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, guitar riff, drums and bass. 0:15 Verse 1. 0:38 Pre-chorus. 0:50 Chorus 1 in half time. 1:21 Verse 2. 1:44 Pre-chorus. 1:56 Chorus 2. 2:27 A drum fill and the tempo drops for the bridge, slow and heavy. 3:00 Outro at the slow tempo, guitar and voice fading out by 3:40.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Early-2010s moody indie pop with a hip-hop rhythm section: dark, clean and reverberant, guitars wide, vocal low in pitch but forward.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The tempo change at 2:27, where the song becomes a different, slower one.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The radio is playing something their parents knew, and the bridge says the shirt was worn before and will be worn after. It is the same autumn night with a longer sense of time around it.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Shy closeness, warmth, a wider view, letting go.
